titulo.alumno: Accepting or declining an invitation politely

intro: In this lesson you will practice accepting or declining an invitation politely.

texto: Identify the activity, the day and the time; reply to an invitation clearly and politely.

frases.alumno: What word do we learn today?

frases.estudio: Ευχαριστώ για την πρόσκληση. Θα έρθω με χαρά.
frases.alumno: Thank you for the invitation. I'll be glad to come.

frases.estudio: Δεν μπορώ απόψε· μπορούμε να συναντηθούμε αύριο;
frases.alumno: I can't tonight; can we meet tomorrow?

frases.estudio: Θέλεις να έρθεις για καφέ το Σάββατο στις επτά;
frases.alumno: Do you want to come for a coffee on Saturday at seven?

pregunta.texto: Listen to the invitation and recognize the plan proposed.
